tools.name: search_endpoints
tools.description: Searches for paid API endpoints (x402) by task in natural language. Returns a structured plan (plan[]) with candidates. IMPORTANT: each candidate contains a routeId. To execute a found endpoint, pass this routeId to the call_endpoint tool. Do not attempt to call the URL directly — use call_endpoint.

tools.name: call_endpoint
tools.description: Executes an endpoint found via search_endpoints. Accepts a routeId and arguments. If payment is required, returns isError=true with payment details in structuredContent. In this case, the agent must sign the payment and retry the call with _meta["x402/payment"]. On success, returns the actual result
